cellValuesByFieldId.fldUWG3CEZUESJ8Dv: The NAC unit is photographic documentation (Dokumentacja fotograficzna) from the collection “Koncern Ilustrowany Kurier Codzienny — Archiwum Ilustracji.” Unit title: “Rewia ‘My chcemy króla’ w Teatrze ‘Perskie Oko’ w Warszawie”; reference 3/1/0/11/11396; former reference 1-K-11396; date April 1926; unit description “Fragment rewii.” The unit contains one image. Object 457897, reference 3/1/0/11/11396/1, is titled “Zula Pogorzelska w jednej ze scen rewii.” The image is used as contextual evidence for Warsaw revue culture and does not by itself establish a work credit for Bronisław Kaper.
